scenarios.title: state-schema.md describes runBranch and the slice branch field by kind
scenarios.notes: Read state-schema.md. The runBranch bullet must say the run branch (run kind under config.branchFormat). The branch field must say the slice branch under config.branchFormat. No sdlc/S-001 or sdlc/run-<n> literal anywhere. Try variants: sdlc/run-3, sdlc/S-0, JSON examples.

scenarios.title: commit-state.md uses the four branch placeholders
scenarios.notes: commit-state.md must hold <slice branch>, <run branch>, <milestone branch> and <state branch>. It must hold no sdlc/ literal and no sdlc/state-. Check every command block, not only the prose.

scenarios.title: The state branch name comes from branches.py, not date -u
scenarios.notes: commit-state.md must hold no date -u. _common.md must map <state branch> to branches.py name --kind state. Run that command in a scratch repo with the default and a custom branchFormat. The output must be a valid branch name and carry the state kind.

scenarios.title: Each of the 13 slice prompts uses <slice branch> and no sdlc/<id> literal
scenarios.notes: Files: implementer, test-writer, test-checker, planner, verifier, verify-planner, verify-toolsmith, test-reporter, gate, finding-refuter, verify-profile-common, verify-collector, state-reader. Each holds <slice branch> and no sdlc/<id>, sdlc/S-, sdlc/run- or loop literal outside branches.py output blocks. A dropped file from the list must fail the test. Check that file names exist.

scenarios.title: state-schema.md names the milestone branch by kind and holds no loop literal
scenarios.notes: The stack bullet must match /milestone/ and hold no sdlc/M-<n>. Only the branchFormat default sdlc/{name} may remain. Scan with the loop branch literal pattern, and with sdlc/S-001, sdlc/run-<n>, sdlc/M-<n>.

scenarios.title: The new tests fail when a literal or placeholder is reverted
scenarios.notes: On a scratch copy, put back each old literal (sdlc/S-001, sdlc/run-<n>, sdlc/M-<n>, date -u, sdlc/<id>) and remove one <slice branch>. The matching test T-R-065b or T-R-063a (R-134), T-R-135, T-R-146 or T-R-149 must fail. Never edit the repo. The prompts must stay clean under ste-check.py. Round 1: review fix deleted duplicate T-R-134. R-134 stays covered by T-R-065b, T-R-063a and T-R-149.

tools.purpose: Run branches.py name --kind state in a scratch repo
Scan the prompt files for forbidden literals and required placeholders

riskReason: Prompt text steers agents that commit and push branches, but this slice mostly adds tests over text that is already in place.
notes: Prompt-only slice. No HTTP, async, data or UI boundary. The contract profile covers the prompt files as the public text surface. The cli profile covers the branches.py link. Round 1 (after review-fix): the fix deleted test T-R-134 only. No scenario added.
